source.title: Flickr:53766352352 — Jeep JL Conversion Adapters
source.author: Spidertrax Off-Road
source.description: Wouldn’t it be nice to open up wheel options from different vehicles? Spidertrax 1-1/2" thick, 5 on 4.5" to 5 on 5", 6061T6 aluminum adapters make it possible to change your wheel bolt pattern. Simply install on a Jeep XJ, YJ, TJ, ZJ, or Liberty axle and this adapter will convert your bolt pattern to the Jeep JL bolt circle. Each kit comes complete with 2 wheel adapters, 10 M14x1.5 Grade 8+ 4140 wheel studs (pre-installed), 10 1/2-20 lug nuts, and a package of thread locker. Each wheel adapter is anodized in blue, using a double anodizing process for twice the corrosion resistance. In addition, each wheel adapter is wheel and hub centric for a perfect fit. Proudly made in the USA. www.spidertrax.com/whs035
